## Issue Templates

This project uses issue templates to standardize reports. Please use the appropriate template when creating a new issue:

- 🐛 **[Bug Report]**: Use for error reports, unexpected behavior, or problems with the tool
- ✨ **[Feature Request]**: Use for new feature suggestions, enhancements, or improvements

When creating an issue, select the appropriate template from the issue creation screen, or let us know if you need help choosing the right one.
